about_the_game:
Collect the Ikkarus and the Prince of Sin game art with this artbook. The PDF contains all the characters' sprites, in-game CGs, and backgrounds we prepared for Ikkaru's story.

What you will find in the art book is:

  • A pdf document with 80 pages showing the material produced during the game development and the final versions presented in it;
  • All CGs from the game;
  • All character sprites and expressions from the game;
  • All backgrounds available in the game.

To access it, you need to go to:

Location:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Ikkarus and the Prince of Sin\Ikkarus and the Prince of Sin - Adult Art Pack.pdf
